respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows an automated deployment and streaming setup for Kingdom petrotechnical software using AppStream 2.0. CloudFormation orchestrates resources including EC2 (serving as license server/image builder automation target), Lambda, Systems Manager, RDS, and FSx. Custom resources and Lambda trigger SSM commands on EC2, which returns a completion signal to CloudFormation via wait conditions. Students access AppStream sessions configured with session scripts mounting FSx and accessing RDS. The icon for an administrator/developer (b0) is captured from visual reading without invented edges per Rule 10.
respuesta.nombre: Automated Kingdom Software Delivery with AppStream 2.0 and CloudFormation
